# Knob Register

The knobs of section 9 of the AgentSandbox threat model, from `crates/sandboxpolicy-core/src/registry.rs`. What knobs and steps are is in [Knobs and Steps](../concepts/knobs.md).

| Knob | Name | Boundary | Loosest step | Approvers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `K1.1` | Web and document fetching | 1 | `R3` | Security |
| `K1.2` | Project instruction loading | 1 | `R2` | PlatformOwner |
| `K1.3` | Tool and MCP set | 1 | `R3` | Security, ToolOwner |
| `K1.4` | Output export | 1 | `R3` | DataOwner |
| `K2.1` | Command execution | 2 | `R3` | Security |
| `K2.2` | Filesystem scope | 2 | `R2` | DataOwner |

## Longest grant per step

A KnobGrant's `expiresAt` may be at most this far from the time it is evaluated (`L012`).

| Target step | Longest lifetime |
| --- | --- |
| `R1` | 90 days |
| `R2` | 30 days |
| `R3` | 7 days |

## Numeric ceilings

From `crates/sandboxpolicy-core/src/ceilings.rs`. Steps above `R2` use the `R2` value.

| Ceiling | `R0` | `R1` | `R2` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| K5.1 token TTL | 300 s | 900 s | 3600 s |
| K4.3 egress bytes per lease | 10485760 | 104857600 | 1073741824 |
| K7.3 lease duration | 14400 s | 28800 s | 86400 s |
| K7.3 concurrent sandboxes | 1 | 2 | 5 |

A policy that sets no tool-call budget gets 500.
